title: Visit to Allen Dulles's former office in Switzerland

tellings.quote: He told us when he got permission to maintain a very active office here that as long as he was in Switzerland, no American law could reach him

plain: Allen Dulles, the wartime spy chief who later ran the CIA, once said that as long as he was in Switzerland, no American law could reach him. Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, tells Michels he heard this from Swiss government officials when he visited Dulles's old office there; they said Dulles told them so when he got permission to keep a very active office in the country. If true, it would show a top American intelligence man setting himself up beyond the reach of US law.
